text: Two changes after the first live amendment's pull request, #6, failed in CI. That was the checker running out of memory, not the code: TLC ran out holding 29,000 recorded steps in one module. First, conformance is now checked in batches of 2,000 steps, each holding only the states it uses, so memory stays flat however large the model grows. Second, `/invariant retry` lets a writer have the factory look again at a pull request that failed, once someone has fixed the cause. The factory still merges only on a green gate at the current head, in scope, with the ratified lock.
